facts.statement: Bukalaris initially delivers Seller Admin, Storefront and Super Admin, with independent platform-hosted checkout and external token-authenticated storefronts. LP/MCP, marketplace, buyer account and affiliate are phased future scope.
facts.evidence: Product direction and headless/checkout clarification by Paduka Ongki on 2026-09-18.
facts.recheck_trigger: Product scope, channel, or actor changes

facts.statement: The initial target market is Indonesia; product UI and customer-facing operational content need id-ID support and IDR money handling.
facts.evidence: Product direction provided by Paduka Ongki on 2026-09-17.
facts.recheck_trigger: New country, currency, or locale launch

facts.statement: The intended Indonesian provider integrations are Mengantar for shipping and AutoLaris H2H for payment instructions and reconciliation.
facts.evidence: Product direction provided by Paduka Ongki on 2026-09-17.
facts.recheck_trigger: Provider contract, account model, or integration strategy changes

facts.statement: Seller commerce data must be centrally modeled by Bukalaris with tenant isolation; arbitrary direct access to seller-owned databases is not an accepted integration model.
facts.evidence: Architecture recommendation derived from CTX-1 and the need for a future managed marketplace.
facts.recheck_trigger: Accepted tenancy or external seller-data decision

facts.statement: No local Bukalaris application repository has been established. This is an independent staged specification, not Bukalaris runtime evidence.
facts.evidence: Local repository inventory inspected during planning; independent product direction confirmed on 2026-09-25.
facts.recheck_trigger: Bukalaris repository path or remote is supplied

facts.statement: Bukalaris uses bukalaris.com with tagline Buka toko langsung laris; Bos at bos.bukalaris.com and Tenant Admin at app.bukalaris.com use Next.js, TypeScript, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
Recommend Astro for marketing and on-demand tenant storefronts, Next.js checkout, and PostgreSQL/Drizzle with a shared commerce core. No implementation or performance benchmark exists.
facts.evidence: Architecture fit assessment and official Next.js/Astro documentation reviewed on 2026-09-25.
facts.recheck_trigger: Prototype evidence or interaction complexity changes

identity.reason: Super admins, sellers, buyers, affiliates, and service identities require separate authorization boundaries.

multi-tenant.reason: One platform operates multiple seller stores and a future marketplace.

public-api.reason: Storefront, seller CMS, integration callbacks, and future seller connectors require stable HTTP boundaries.

custom-domain.reason: Per-seller native custom domains are accepted; independent headless origins and platform checkout are separate bindings.

shared-ui.reason: The console, Seller CMS, buyer account, and storefront need reusable accessible UI behavior.

product-ui.reason: The product has maintained browser-visible admin, seller, buyer, and storefront workflows.

commerce.reason: Checkout, payment, shipping, COD, discounts, future marketplace settlement, and affiliate commissions are in scope.

personal-data.reason: Buyer accounts, seller accounts, delivery addresses, orders, and support operations process personal data.

production-service.reason: The platform must be observable and operable as a public commerce service.

delivery.reason: User requested complete development documentation for maintained initial surfaces and hosted checkout.

locales.regional_rules: IDR uses integer rupiah; date, number, and address formatting must use locale-aware platform APIs.
locales.accessibility: WCAG scope is Unknown pending owner decision.
